name: gather_wood
description: Mine at least 30 wood from nearby trees.
task: Hold at least 30 Wood (any kind: Wood, BorealWood, PalmWood...).

name: gather_and_craft_workbench
description: Collect 30 Wood and craft one WorkBench.
task: Hold a work bench (any wood variant counts, e.g. BorealWoodWorkBench).

name: make_wooden_hammer
description: Gather wood, build a workbench, and craft one WoodenHammer.
task: Hold a wooden hammer (any wood variant counts).

name: mine_stone_blocks
description: Mine at least 30 StoneBlock using the available pickaxe.

name: make_wooden_chair_table
description: Gather wood, build a workbench, craft a wooden hammer, then craft a wooden chair and table.
task: Hold a wooden chair and a wooden table (any wood variant counts).

name: get_and_hold_wooden_hammer
description: Crafts a WoodenHammer from nearby trees and equips it as the main weapon.
task: Hold a wooden hammer (any wood variant counts).

name: make_wooden_door
description: Gather wood, create a WorkBench, and craft one WoodenDoor.
task: Hold a wooden door (any wood variant counts).
